caption: The drawing features a single object: a bonnet. The bonnet consists of a structured, oval-shaped brim made of a woven, light brown straw-like material. Attached to the back is a soft, gathered fabric in a grayish-blue color forming a bag-like covering. Two long, wide ribbons, shaded in dark blue with lighter edges, extend downward from the bottom of the bonnet. The composition is centered on a plain beige background with no additional objects or details.
title: Bonnet
